about: Deterministic Python/browser transition fixtures for deeparcade P0-07. Expected records were generated from the Python environment (src/narcade/snake.py), the specification the browser core mirrors, with food placement scripted by the food_script queue (initial placement first, one entry per eat; an exhausted queue on a filled board means food null). Both replay drivers inject the start state and the scripted placer, apply the same actions, and must reproduce every record exactly.
